why: This is a narrow neurocognitive account of imitation-based social learning, so its findings belong as a mechanistic extension and qualification of Social Learning Theory rather than as a new general theory.

rejected.verifier: The finding concerns session-dependent neural coupling in the mirror-neuron system, not Social Learning Theory’s modeling component or practice, although its stated temporal direction matches the evidence.
